binding: Current owning source hashes below, including uncommitted reviewed readiness persistence fix and edge attestation response. This is not approval of uninspected later source changes.

closedFindings.issue: Continuous readiness polling previously persisted a fresh full CPU/GPU audit bundle every 15 seconds without retention, allowing unbounded volume growth.
closedFindings.resolution: SupplyMonitor invokes verify(persist_evidence=False); full verification is retained while monitoring audit files are not written. Actual chat/default verification persists audit evidence as before.
closedFindings.verification: Independent source review and Python suite; dedicated regression covers 100 memory-only events with no files and normal persistent audit event.

independentChecks.rustOwningSource: Reviewed modified dynamic receipt market ID and supply gate; Rust compile/integration not rerun by this reviewer.

findings.signedSettlement: Executor verifies attested receipt keyset, original request and idempotency binding before projection. Projection checks safe nonnegative integer fields, cash=provider+platform-promo, fee agreement, zero held amount, terminal committed receipt and authorization bound. It does not create a second money ledger.
findings.unknownRecovery: Receipt absence stays pending/invalid rather than inventing cost. Reconcile queries the original receipt and never dispatches a new purchase; unknown delivery can remain unknown even after money settles.
findings.supplyGate: Readiness requires active instance plus existing gateway CPU/GPU verification and expires; Market middleware rejects non-ready supply before original cash admission. Gateway independently checks and verifies again before inference. No model invocation is made by UI polling.
findings.persistence: New /data/baseline-b-v2 namespace retains /data/chutes-run. Existing runtime/settings are resumed; no automatic ledger refill or replacement buyer verifying keys. Overlay generator preservation assertions and synthetic tests passed; no private actual manifest was read.
findings.retainedSecurity: Owning main retains sealed catalog/dynamic receipt market binding, signed purchase and attestation layers, and controlled-mode/live exclusion. Preview edge reports attestation not_checked rather than claiming verified TEE TLS.
findings.networkChange: Overlay explicitly adds preview to existing default Docker network for whitelisted GET market:8080/market/v1/supply. Original separate-bridge-only isolation no longer applies; credentials, old persistent volumes and sealed environment are not mounted into preview by this change.

limitations: Scope is signed USD credit-ledger settlement and readiness. Public agent UI remains controlled P2. Native/testnet components are not live B authority and their incompleteness is not a blocker to this scoped release.
No new production image/archive hashes, actual private compose preservation, Phala update or hosted B inference was independently validated in this review.
Bootstrap first-time warmup/calibration and finite qualification remain operator-controlled existing behavior; readiness polling itself does not start a GPU.
Readiness hash for nonpersistent monitor evidence is ephemeral; real inference audit evidence remains durable.
Initial tests on Node24.7 and system Python failed due declared runtime/dependency requirements; supported runtime reruns passed as recorded.
